player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of HighSociety (2-player version).
Game flow:  Ten prestige cards are auctioned one after another.
Bidding:    Each auction, secretly choose a money card 1-11 and reveal.
            • Higher bid wins the prestige card and discards that money card.
            • Lower bid keeps their money card.
            • Tie -> both bids are returned and the same prestige card is re-auctioned.
Scoring:    After all ten auctions, add **remaining cash + prestige points**.
            Higher *net-worth* wins (exact tie -> draw).

**Action syntax**  →  bid a single card like '[7]' or '[11]'.
